author: reek
body: Texture mapping from Codex [Device] AST: a Mode-7-style perspective ground plane. One GPU thread per pixel projects the pixel onto an infinite textured floor, tiles the world coordinate into a 256x256 texture the host uploaded into a storage buffer, samples the texel (device-load), and fogs it by distance. The floor scrolls with the frame. This is the reference site's "texture" technique -- the sampling and perspective are real Codex, reading a real uploaded texture.

author: reek
body: The texture is a 256x256 array of packed RGB integers at binding 0; the output framebuffer is binding 1. Integer fixed point throughout.

author: reek
body: Fog by screen-space depth: far (near the horizon, small sy) fades to a haze.
